annotation.bound_parties_text: The Act authorizes the department of transportation and department of justice to make rules on vehicles with automated driving systems, and governs the use of such vehicles on Montana public highways; local governments may not discriminate against them.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: The department of transportation may adopt rules that limit the use of commercial vehicles with automated driving systems in actual or predicted periods of dangerous road conditions.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE USE OF VEHICLES WITH AUTOMATED DRIVING SYSTEMS ON STATE PUBLIC HIGHWAYS
